title: Native memory storage
content: The OpenCode native memory sidecar stores searchable records in zvec and persists lifecycle metadata in an atomic JSON state file.

title: Hybrid retrieval
content: Memory search combines dense llama.cpp embeddings with lexical full-text search, reciprocal rank, taxonomy-aware calibration, and MMR diversification.

title: Session family scope
content: Session-scoped memory is shared by the primary OpenCode session, child subagents, and sibling subagents that resolve to the same root session ID.

title: Repository memory
content: Reviewed canonical team knowledge is stored as Markdown under .opencode/memory and synchronized into repository scope.

title: Document ingestion
content: The memory_ingest tool extracts project-local PDF, Markdown, and HTML documents with xberg and stores bounded searchable chunks as private memory.

title: Embedding model
content: The default embedding model is Qwen3-Embedding-4B-GGUF with last-token pooling, causal attention, normalization, and a native dimension of 2560.

title: Tombstone revival
content: Deleted semantic content leaves a tombstone by default and can only be stored again when revive is explicitly approved.

title: Retrieval benchmark baselines
content: The frozen retrieval benchmark compares no-memory, lexical-only, dense-only, and current hybrid search over the same versioned corpus.
